comment.text: ARAF S214 is represented as a recurrently mutated residue in Cancer Hotspots v1, v2. Statistical enrichment supports review as a candidate somatic hotspot; it does not establish the functional effect, pathogenicity, or treatment sensitivity of every alteration at this position.
